ToLocalTime is applied in both scripts (verified). But the claim that the storage of gen_valuedate is unproven can be answered from the supplied files. The only supplied writer of Gen_ftCurrentYearBase.Gen_ValueDate is 0008_LeumiFile-PY (five OLE DB inserts 'insert ftCurrentYearBase 1-5'). Every one of them receives gen_ValueDate through script 'FT\Dates ToUniveral', which parses the date string and applies ToUniversalTime before the insert. So rows written by the supplied packages store gen_valuedate in UTC, and ToLocalTime converts back correctly for them. Only writers outside the supplied files remain unknown.
